about.title: California City Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing a loved one in a Kern County traffic collision changes everything, and the last thing a grieving family should have to untangle is a legal process. California City recorded 5 traffic deaths alongside 14 injury collisions in the most recent final crash year, numbers that represent real families along corridors like Neuralia Road, Randsburg Mojave Road, and Rt 58. California law gives certain surviving family members, starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children, the right to bring a wrongful death claim, though the window to act is limited. Our team handles wrongful death claims for families in California City. We'll review what happened, explain your options, and manage the legal work while you focus on your family. There's no cost to speak with us, and no fee unless your case recovers something for you.

whyChoose.title: Why Families in California City Choose Us

items.title: Understanding Who Can File
items.desc: California limits standing in wrongful death cases, generally to a spouse, domestic partner, or children first, with other dependents or heirs eligible in certain situations. We can help clarify where your family stands before time runs short.

items.title: Awareness of the Filing Deadline
items.desc: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim, though claims against a government entity carry a much shorter deadline. Missing either window can end your family's ability to recover anything.

items.title: No Upfront Cost to Get Answers
items.desc: We work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless we recover compensation for your family. That lets you get guidance now without adding financial strain to an already difficult time.

items.question: Who in our family is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: California law generally gives priority to a surviving spouse, registered domestic partner, and children. If none of those exist, certain other dependents or heirs may be eligible. We can review your family's specific situation to confirm who has standing.

items.question: How much time do we have to file after a death in California City?
items.answer: In most cases, California allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death lawsuit. If the claim involves a government road or entity, such as a county-maintained stretch of Randsburg Mojave Road, the deadline can be much shorter. It's worth contacting us promptly so you don't lose that option.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim connected to any criminal charges filed against the other driver?
items.answer: No, a wrongful death claim is a separate civil matter from any criminal prosecution, and the two proceed independently. A criminal case, if there is one, does not need to conclude before a civil claim moves forward. Many families pursue the civil claim to address financial losses and support regardless of what happens criminally.

items.question: What kinds of losses can a wrongful death claim cover?
items.answer: California law allows recovery for costs like funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the deceased would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. Every situation is different, and we can walk through what may apply to your family's circumstances.
